I have been farming these beans for many years and I know they grow well enough without buying expensive fertilizer, especially since I do not grow maize on this plot. I keep my own bean seed from the last harvest, and there is no need for chemicals or irrigation when the rains come to Mangochi. My family and I will tend this plot ourselves as we always do, saving our small amount of money for other household needs.
